summary: Fixes three bare-metal restore regressions: (1) backup's runtime-recovery/ root archived at umask-dependent 0775, fixed via chmod plus a verify-extractable pre-upload check; (2) canonical fdkaac/TTS publication ran unprivileged and was refused by E4/E3 -- Stage 50/70 now escalate publish under sudo; (3) the recovery receipt dir can't be created unprivileged on a fresh machine -- lib.sh now establishes it via sudo first. No migration/dependency/package/service changes.
